Ivory slide: finding 1 of 5, “They already sell on WhatsApp.” 61% of women-owned sellers on Jumia in Côte d’Ivoire, Kenya and Nigeria also sell on WhatsApp. Source: IFC, Women and E-commerce in Africa, 2021. A white card on what JEERE does about it: Orders and stock in one place, wherever the order comes from.

Ivory slide: finding 2 of 5, “Social media is the shop window.” 67% of small businesses surveyed promote themselves on social media, and 45% sell online. Source: Africa MSME Pulse, 2023. A white card on what JEERE does about it: A shop link made to be shared, in a bio and in a DM.

Ivory slide: finding 3 of 5, “A marketplace does not replace social.” Over 90% of Kenyan micro-businesses that used a marketplace also sold through social media. Source: Mastercard Foundation and Caribou Digital, 2020. A white card on what JEERE does about it: One stock for every channel, so nothing sells twice.

Ivory slide: finding 4 of 5, “The phone is the computer.” 416 million people used mobile internet in Africa in 2024. Source: GSMA, The Mobile Economy Africa 2025. A white card on what JEERE does about it: The whole shop is set up and run from a phone.

Ivory slide: finding 5 of 5, “Signal is not the barrier. Use is.” 58% of unconnected Africans already live under mobile broadband coverage. Source: GSMA, The Mobile Economy Africa 2025. A white card on what JEERE does about it: Short steps, in French first, that tick themselves.

Graphic designer and design historian. Her 1985 Pratt thesis on Black designers became “Black Designers Missing in Action”, published by Print in 1987. What I took from their work: Writing down who is missing is design work too.

Artist, Minister of Culture of the Black Panther Party. He shaped the look of The Black Panther newspaper from 1967. AIGA Medal, 2015. What I took from their work: Design can speak for a community, in its own visual language.
Graphic designer, writer and educator. Senior art director at Rolling Stone from 1987 to 2002. AIGA Lifetime Achievement Medal, 2008. What I took from their work: Lettering can carry a whole voice.

Designer, founder of Off-White. Founded Off-White in 2013. Named artistic director of Louis Vuitton menswear in 2018. What I took from their work: You do not need permission to work across disciplines.
Cameroonian tech entrepreneur. Founded AppsTech in 1999. Chairs ActivSpaces, a tech hub in Buea. What I took from their work: You can build from Africa and be taken seriously everywhere.
